title: Regular Expressions: Regexes in Python (Part 2)
description: Explore more regex tools in Python, including the re module's search, substitution, and utility functions, compiled regexes, and match objects.
summary: In the previous tutorial in this series, you covered a lot of ground. You saw how to use re.search() to perform pattern matching with regexes in Python and learned about the many regex metacharacters and parsing flags that you can use to fine-tune your pattern-matching capabilities.
takeaways: You saw how to use re.search() to perform pattern matching with regexes in Python and learned about the many regex metacharacters and parsing flags that you can use to fine-tune your pattern-matching capabilities.

In this tutorial, you’ll: Explore more functions, beyond re.search() , that the re module provides Learn when and how to precompile a regex in Python into a regular expression object Discover useful things that you can do with the match object returned by the functions in the re module Ready?

Get Your Code: Click here to download the free sample code that shows you how to use the functions and objects in Python’s re module. re Module Functions In addition to re.search() , the re module contains several other functions to help you perform regex-related tasks.
